sample_frame.earlier_corpus_receipt: prior v2 nonreuse lists 528 historical metadata files; this packet does not reread that corpus or claim its full-content coverage

normalization.titles: UTF-8 NFC, HTML unescape, URL percent-decode, underscores to spaces, casefold
normalization.urls: drop query/fragment, casefold host, NFC/percent-decode/underscore normalization of path
normalization.sha1: hex lowercase as provided; left-pad to 40 characters to account for omitted leading zero in historical metadata
normalization.origin_ids: YouTube and Vimeo numeric/string work IDs extracted from provenance, case preserved, plus Commons own-work page ID where source declares own work
normalization.licensing_identity: underlying work ID + attributed author identity URL/name + license URL; a shared standard license URL alone is not source reuse. For these three, author names and URLs are also all disjoint from prior sources.
